tie_reference: TIE (2026). Business Studies for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.
source_note: Verified Business Studies Form One lesson plans (Arusha Catholic Seminary). 52 lesson plans: 26 Term I lesson plans (1A-13B) covering Introduction to Business Studies (Chapter 1), Entrepreneurship (Chapter 2) and Sole Proprietorship (Chapter 3), and 26 Term II lesson plans (14A-26B) covering revision of Chapters 1-3, a practical business project and annual revision. Week 10 of each term is mid-term assessment and break. 3 periods per week (one 80-min double and one 40-min single period).

lessons.title: BUSINESS STUDIES FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 1A (TERM I - WEEK 1, DOUBLE PERIOD - 80 min): CONCEPT OF A BUSINESS
lessons.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate understanding of the concept, terminologies, and scope of Business Studies
lessons.specific_competence: 1.1 Explain the concept of a business
lessons.specific_activity: Examine business processes (production, distribution, exchange, consumption) and the purpose of a business
lessons.teaching_learning_resources: Business Studies textbook, local business examples.
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Business Studies for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks students to trace where the maize they eat at home came from before it reached their plate.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Share ideas tracing the food's journey.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Explains in depth the four business processes - production, distribution, exchange, and consumption - using the maize example and other local cases.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take detailed notes and draw a flow-chart of the four processes.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct sequencing of the four processes

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides groups to trace the four processes for a different local product (e.g. a soda, a school uniform).
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Trace processes for a chosen product in groups.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Facilitates group presentations and consolidates key points on the board.

lessons.title: BUSINESS STUDIES FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 1B (TERM I - WEEK 1, SINGLE PERIOD - 40 min): PURPOSE OF A BUSINESS
lessons.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate understanding of the concept, terminologies, and scope of Business Studies
lessons.specific_competence: 1.1 Explain the concept of a business
lessons.main_activity: Explain the purpose of a business
lessons.specific_activity: Examine why businesses exist (profit, providing goods/services, employment)
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Business Studies for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps the four business processes from the double period.
Explains the main purposes of a business (making profit, meeting customer needs, creating jobs) with local examples.
Guides individual listing of purposes served by a chosen local business.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: List purposes for a chosen business individually.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Reviews answers orally and consolidates on the board.

lessons.title: BUSINESS STUDIES FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 2A (TERM I - WEEK 2, DOUBLE PERIOD - 80 min): NEEDS AND WANTS

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks students to list things they "must have" versus things they "would like to have."
Explains in depth the difference between needs (necessities) and wants (desires), with picture card examples.

teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct differentiation of needs and wants

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides group sorting of picture cards into needs and wants categories, discussing borderline cases.
Reviews group sorting and consolidates on the board.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Present sorted cards to the class.

lessons.title: BUSINESS STUDIES FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 2B (TERM I - WEEK 2, SINGLE PERIOD - 40 min): SERVICES
